title: Section 230.85 – Add an Exception at the end of Section 230.85 to read as follows:
officialText:
Exception: If the emergency disconnecting means cannot be located in a readily accessible outdoor location, or if the
utility metering equipment is located indoors, 1 of the following disconnecting means shall be permitted:
1. A remote disconnecting means provided by the utility
2. An indoor shunt-trip disconnecting means with the control device located in a readily accessible outdoor location
and marked, “Remote Emergency Disconnect”
3. An approved equivalent means.
